name: system
description: System operations: health/list_resources/enable_api/disable_api. `list_resources` defaults to an essential projection (uuid/name/type/status) to keep token budgets sane on instances with many resources; pass `include_full: true` for the raw Coolify payload. When `include_full: true`, credentials are masked unless `reveal: true` is also set (matches the `env_vars` `reveal` ergonomics): webhook HMAC secrets, basic-auth password, database passwords, internal/external_db_url connection strings, compose bodies, custom_labels, and nested env-var values.
